== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Lutoch Terelle]] is an individual known unofficially as the Oracle of [[Solstice]]. A licensed [[Archmage]] specializing in predictive divination, she utilizes her expertise to unravel mysteries and process information by comparing it against the [[Aether]]. While [[Solstice]] is a [[Shadow|shadow]] organization that exerts control over the [[Galactic Union]], it is also described as a collection of [[World Spirits]]. Terelle serves as an employee for this entity, though she has perceived [[Solstice]] as a distant and nearly incomprehensible force. She is capable of sensing ongoing battles while in a sensory deprivation tank, and some believe the figure known as the Oracle is actually a magical connection acting as a spokesperson for the group.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Oracle]] of [[Solstice]] is a mysterious entity believed to possess the power of mind reading and foresight, communicating with others through various messages. While some believe this figure is located on the planet [[Zykaros]], others suspect its presence on [[Omega]]'s home world. The crew has actively pursued leads regarding the entity, which is identified as [[Lutoch Terelle]]. During their investigations, a target being dragged was suspected to be the Oracle itself.}}
